Population increased in Wandsworth

The estimated population of Wandsworth in 2024 was 337,655 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

This meant that Wandsworth's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Wandsworth increased by 2.8%.

Over this slightly longer period, Wandsworth was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Wandsworth

The average (median) age fell to 33 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Wandsworth has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Wandsworth is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Wandsworth's population of 337,655 usual residents was made up of:

  • 52,774 people aged 0 to 15 years, (15.6%)
  • 251,330 people aged 16 to 64 years, (74.4%)
  • 33,551 people aged 65 years and over, (9.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Wandsworth has a higher proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (74.4% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Wandsworth, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Wandsworth
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Wandsworth, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 2,309 people (0.7%). In total, there were 3,848 births and 1,539 deaths in Wandsworth.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 1,056 (-0.3%). There were 41,963 people entering the area and 43,019 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Wandsworth's population of 2,578 (0.8%) as a result of 8,221 people entering the area and 5,643 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Wandsworth was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Wandsworth in mid-2023 is 333,859.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 2,763 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 360 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 2,403 people.
